summary: The concrete October setup writer now commits one complete immutable v2 setup snapshot atomically, retains first-commit UTC time across fresh equivalent authorization, and rejects changed retries without partial state.

superseded_fixture_result.resolution: OctoberDbContext now preserves an explicitly supplied alternate controlled provider while retaining Npgsql fixed-history configuration.

behavioral_red.observation: All cases compiled, reached the concrete OctoberSetupStore through IOctoberSetupWriter and failed at the intentionally unimplemented CommitAsync.

minimal_green.result: 7/7 store behavior tests passed before final migration and shape work

final_green.policy: 287 classified sources; build completed with zero errors

model_and_migration: Static parity covers five fixed-october setup tables, keys, cascade foreign keys, one-selection and state constraints, and the separate October migrations history convention. No live PostgreSQL migration or provider-equivalence claim is made.
test_owner_assessment: The public writer test uses an owned in-memory SQLite database, deterministic clock and complete two-Repository v2 snapshot. Retry uses newly materialized record/list/context objects with identical semantics, proving instance independence and original SelectedAtUtc. No further test refactor was needed.
production_owner_assessment: The store localizes atomic write/replay/conflict reconciliation and persists only setup-owned metadata. The context localizes mappings and provider composition. Final-shape work tightened the pre-commit cancellation boundary and exact retained-batch reconciliation after uncertain failure; no further refactor was justified.
remaining_scope: Prepared-source approvals, production source adapter, existing-batch selector, generator composition, context projection, provider binding, diagnostics and explicit owned-resource qualification remain open.
